item.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.

item.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.

item.title: Wacom’s MovinkPad 11 is a fun, midpriced entry point for digital artists
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The MovinkPad 11 a versatile little graphics tablet that can help make your wildest digital art dreams come true.

item.title: Security researchers scanned the Polish web and found courts, hospitals, and airports at risk of hacks
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Researchers found common points of failure, like software used to organize and display web content, could have allowed hackers to run riot through government websites.

item.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. It uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.

item.title: Computer maker Framework notifies ‘all customers’ of a data breach
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: Framework told "all" of its customers that hackers accessed their names, email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses in a data breach.

item.title: Today’s the last day to get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

item.title: Trump administration has spent nearly $4B to cancel offshore wind farms
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: The Trump administration has now convinced developers to abandon 12 offshore wind leases. The latest will cost taxpayers $1.2 billion.

item.title: Host your own piece of Disrupt: Apply to run a Side Event at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: You put together the concept — from a founder mixer, an after-hours panel, a themed party, a morning run, whatever fits your goal — and the TechCrunch team helps put it in front of the attendees already in town for Disrupt.

item.title: Chinese AI model Kimi escaped its cybersecurity testing environment, researchers say
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: In the Kimi test, the sandbox designed to contain the experiment was not properly configured.

item.title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Airbnb will debut a new AI-powered search experience with a toggle.

item.title: SpaceX’s Terafab will rely on natural gas power plants, not Tesla solar panels
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: The fab is intended to build chips for data centers that will be run by SpaceX and its xAI subsidiary.

item.title: The founder’s guide to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Everything you need to know
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is built around one question: How do you build an enduring company in the AI era? Our programming and speaker lineup reflect that.

item.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay additional $567M in child safety case
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Meta's total fine has racked up to $942 million in this case.

item.title: OpenAI’s new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Additional details about OpenAI's mysterious new AI device make it sound like a pricey smart speaker.

item.title: Vogue just gave another nod of approval to the tech world
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Vogue World is coming to San Francisco next year — perhaps another indication that tech bros are now part of the fashion zeitgeist.

item.title: Google says hackers are calling financial firm employees to hack and extort victims
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: Groups of hackers are breaking into large U.S. financial firms to steal sensitive data and extort victims, Google’s security researchers report.

item.title: China-linked LightSpy spyware caught targeting victims in 13 countries, including the US
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Researchers linked the latest malicious activity to a Chinese company, after one of the spyware's operators placed an order with KFC using their real name and office address.

item.title: Defense tech Hadrian raises $1.37B at $8B valuation
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Hadrian is building automated factories to mass-produce parts for defense vehicles like submarines. It's backed by a long list of well-known investors.
